2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c file to stop khugepaged from interfering with MADV_COLLAPSE cases by clearing per-order controls in addition to global controls. The problem it solves is that khugepaged was collapsing the range being tested, causing test failures. The approach taken is to set the per-order controls to 'inherit' instead of 'never', allowing MADV_COLLAPSE on shmem to still find an order to build.
